messages:
michelle_pm: Flagging a new customer ask from ACME: they want an 'Optimize Advisor' pilot that can (1) recommend batching/cache/quant per-route, (2) progressively apply quantization (int8 -> int4 later) with safety gates, and (3) automatically roll back on eval-detected quality regressions. They want a lightweight UI + per-customer pilot. Can we scope a minimal, safe pilot?

nathan_eng: +1 on minimal. Proposal: pilot supports heuristics-based recommendations, adaptive microbatching presets, and int8 recommendations only. Progressive quantization (int4) deferred to post-pilot. Important: runtime must support per-customer per-route flags and a safe revert.

michelle_pm: Good. ACME has two main routes: chat (interactive) and analytics (batch). They expect chat p99 <= 150ms, analytics throughput > 400 tok/s. They can provide corpora.

sara_ml: Eval plan: offline quick-eval against customer corpus before apply (estimates rel/abs deltas). Block apply if rel_drop > 1.5%. Post-apply, run live evals and trigger alerts on rel_drop >2% AND abs_drop >0.005. On alert: auto-sample 100% for 30m and optionally route to full-precision fallback if enabled.

leah_cs: ACME wants audit logs (who applied/reverted + timestamp) and a per-route opt-out API. They also asked for cost delta estimates pre-apply (USD per 1M tokens).

michelle_pm: Ops constraints?

tim_sre: Ops: must be feature-flagged per-customer and per-route with canary rollout (5%->25%->100%). Add a global kill-switch and a circuit-breaker that disables adaptive batching if error-rate or e2e p99 worsens >10%. Expose metrics: batch_size_dist, cache_hit_rate, p50/p95/p99 by route, applied_recs_count, revert_count, eval_alert_count. Ensure sampled inputs are PII-obfuscated before storage.

nathan_eng: Runtime example (pilot config displayed in UI):
```yaml
opt_advisor_pilot: true
routes:
  chat:
    adaptive_batching: true
    max_wait_ms: 15
    max_batch_size: 8
    recommend_quant: int8
  analytics:
    adaptive_batching: true
    max_wait_ms: 150
    max_batch_size: 64
    recommend_quant: int8
eval_alerts:
  rel_drop_threshold: 0.02
  abs_min_delta: 0.005
  sample_on_alert_duration_min: 30
```

sara_ml: Suggest adding an "explainability" blurb for each recommendation: why we suggested int8 (est perf gain X%, est quality delta Y%), and required guardrails. UI should show estimated cost savings and a confidence band.

leah_cs: ACME insists on manual approval for any recommendation in pilot (no auto-apply). They want a one-click apply in Console that triggers a 5% canary by default and shows cost/quality estimates. Also need a revert button that reverts config and logs it.

jenna_product: Proposed acceptance checklist for pilot: (1) staging soak 72h with chat p99 SLO met on pilot config; (2) offline eval job runs <30min and blocks unsafe applies; (3) synthetic regressions trigger eval alerts and sampling; (4) canary flows + revert button tested; (5) Console shows estimated perf/cost deltas and audit history; (6) docs + runbook written. Two-sprint timeline.

nathan_eng: We should also include a lightweight recommender heuristic that maps route_type -> presets and a tiny profiler to estimate perf/cost by sampling 50-100 requests. Keep the heavy ML model for later.

michelle_pm: Decision check: include int8 only for pilot and postpone int4/progressive quant for a later phase?

sara_ml: Agree. int8 reduces risk and makes eval numbers clearer. Keep progressive quantization as a follow-on once pilot demonstrates low false-positive rate on eval alerts.

leah_cs: ACME OK with int8 only.

tim_sre: Acknowledged. We'll add nightly perf jobs to detect regressions from kernel/scheduler changes and add a backlog alert for the sampling pipeline.

ci-bot: Build queued: feature/opt-advisor-pilot -> staging (#9101)

michelle_pm: Action items: nathan - implement heuristics + profiler + runtime flags; sara - wire offline eval + live eval hooks + alert rules; tim - canary controls + circuit-breaker + metrics; jenna - PRD + Console mock + runbook; leah - confirm ACME corpus and opt-out API format. I'll consolidate into PRD after updates. Please ack here when started.

nathan_eng: Ack, starting this sprint.

sara_ml: Ack, will prototype eval runner and synthetic regression tests.

tim_sre: Ack, will add canary endpoints and kill-switch.

jenna_product: Ack, drafting PRD and mockups.

leah_cs: Ack, taking point on customer comms and corpus collection.

michelle_pm: Thanks team  I'll post PRD link in this thread once it's ready. Closing for decisions but keep status updates here for PRD stitching.
